0-0.speaker: caption
0-0.text: Forty kilometres inland, the Deepwell drill hit something that bled.

0-1.speaker: caption
0-1.text: Three days later, Kessa Port is still evacuating.

1-0.speaker: announcer
1-0.text: All civilians to the piers. Stay off open ground. Repeat: stay off open ground.

2-0.speaker: command
2-0.text: Last ship loads in twenty. Garrison Nine holds the yard.

3-1.speaker: warden
3-1.text: Contact. They’re coming up through the cracks.

0-0.speaker: caption
0-0.text: The last ship clears the breakwater.

1-0.speaker: command
1-0.text: Garrison Nine, the swarm is moving inland. Toward the refinery.

1-1.speaker: warden
1-1.text: They’re not chasing people. They’re chasing heat.

2-0.speaker: caption
2-0.text: Deepwell Refinery. Eleven million litres of fuel.

2-1.speaker: warden
2-1.text: Then that’s where we stop them.

0-0.speaker: caption
0-0.text: The Kiln goes down. Its core keeps burning for a full minute.

0-1.speaker: command
0-1.text: Warden. Look at the drill tower.

1-0.speaker: caption
1-0.text: Under the rig, the borehole. Wide as a street. Breathing heat.

1-1.speaker: command
1-1.text: We didn’t find them. We drilled into their house.

2-0.speaker: command
2-0.text: Seal it. Charges at the bottom of the shaft.

0-1.speaker: command
0-1.text: Charge is set. The fuse is manual. Someone stays.

1-1.speaker: warden
1-1.text: No. Get them to the lift, Hale. That’s an order.

2-0.speaker: caption
2-0.text: The shaft starts to shake. Something big is climbing.

0-0.speaker: caption
0-0.text: The fuse is lit. The charge is counting down.

0-1.speaker: command
0-1.text: Lift’s loaded. Warden, get on. Now.

1-0.speaker: caption
1-0.text: The floor of the well splits. A black dome climbs out on short crab legs. Eight vents, burning like furnaces.

1-1.speaker: command
1-1.text: That’s the mother. That’s what they were keeping warm.

2-0.speaker: command
2-0.text: She’s on top of the charge. If she pulls it loose, it was all for nothing.

2-1.speaker: warden
2-1.text: Then she doesn’t leave the shaft.

3-1.speaker: warden
3-1.text: Take the lift up, Hale. I’ve got her.

0-0.speaker: caption
0-0.text: The last vent bursts. Ashmaw sinks back into the well she came from.

1-0.speaker: caption
1-0.text: The charge blows. The Deepwell folds in on itself, and on her.

1-1.speaker: caption
1-1.text: Without the heat, the Cinderborn slow. Then stop. Then sleep.

2-0.speaker: command
2-0.text: Lift’s coming back down, Warden. You coming up?

3-0.speaker: caption
3-0.text: Kessa Yard. Dawn. Cold, for the first time in weeks.

0-1.speaker: command
0-1.text: Warden’s down! Get up — we hold this together.
